Theme

Common words: verbs, qualities & ideas

round adjective

shaped like a circle or a ball

also circular, rounded, spherical

classical

Hor. Ep. 1.1.100: mūtat quadrāta rotundīs
Cic. N.D. 2.48

rotundus, rotunda, rotundum

Declension on Wiktionary

round, circular, spherical

Other words

  • orbiculātus, orbiculāta, orbiculātum — round, circular (of fruit and leaves)

    also used · classical · Plin. NH 15.51; Varr. RR 1.59: māla orbiculāta (Lewis & Short) · Declension on Wiktionary

  • globōsus, globōsa, globōsum — round like a ball, spherical

    also used · classical · Cic. N.D. 2.116 (Lewis & Short) · Declension on Wiktionary

Examples

  • dīruit, aedificat, mūtat quadrāta rotundīs

    he pulls down, builds, changes square for round (of a man who turns everything upside down)Hor. Ep. 1.1.100

  • quae nunc melimēla dīcuntur ā sapōre melleō, orbiculāta ā figūrā orbis in rotunditātem circumāctī

    the apples now called honey-apples, for their honey taste, and roundies, for their shape, turned into a perfect roundPlin. NH 15.51

See also square, triangle, ball, round.
